title: OutcomeBound review council configuration v1
description: The optional file `.outcomebound/council.json` of a project, or `.outcomebound/council.json` in the home folder of a person, that `outcomebound review council` reads: the reviewers that run when `--reviewer` and `--council` name none, optional settings the command line overrides, and, in the person's file only, named councils and the account folder of each harness. The project's file supplies the reviewers, lens, timeout and cap where it exists, and the person's file is not merged with it; the person's councils and homes apply also where a project file exists, and a project file that defines either is refused.

reviewers.description: Each entry is `harness:model[:effort]`, as `--reviewer` takes it. A harness with no built-in default needs its model; an effort left out leaves the tool's own effort. With none, the built-in default council runs.

lens.description: What the reviewers look at, as `--lens` gives it.

timeout_seconds.description: The time limit for each reviewer, as `--timeout` gives it.

budget_usd.description: A spend cap for Claude reviewers, as `--budget-usd` gives it: a number of US dollars as text.

councils.description: The person's file only: a name (a plain word, such as `pair`) for each list of seats, each `harness:model[:effort]` as `--reviewer` takes it. `--council NAME` runs those seats. The engine checks the names and the seats, since this format has no rule for the keys of an object.

homes.description: The person's file only: the account folder each harness starts with, an absolute path (a leading `~` is the home folder). `codex` sets CODEX_HOME and `claude` sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The plan prints it as its canonical path, the reviewer starts with that path, and the plan id covers it; a path with a control character is refused.
